home.title: Kin: nothing about Mom’s money without Mom
home.description: Kin lets a family share the cost of caring for a parent fairly and in the open, while giving the parent a voice in every decision about their own money.

hero.title: One month with Rose’s family.
hero.lede: Kin is easiest to understand by watching it work. Here is one month in one family, from the first agreement to the settlement at the end.

entries.title: The family agrees
entries.text: Elena creates a circle for her mother Rose and invites Marcus and Ana. They agree on shares: Marcus 50 percent, Elena 30 percent, Ana 20 percent. Hands-on care hours count too, at a rate they choose together. Each sibling sets up a monthly contribution to the family pool. Rose joins with the role “decides”: purchases above 50 dollars need her spoken yes.

entries.title: Rose hears a bill being paid
entries.text: Rose’s phone rings with a calm voice from Kin. She does not have to open anything.
entries.speaker: Kin
entries.quote: Good morning Rose. Your electricity bill of 84 dollars was paid from the family pool this morning. Nothing else is due this week.
entries.approval: The family, when it approved the biller

entries.title: Amara bills by voice, and is paid
entries.text: Amara finishes her third visit of the week and tells Kin her hours. Kin prepares the bill and reads it back. Elena approves it with one tap. Amara’s phone confirms the payment before she reaches her car.
entries.speaker: Amara
entries.quote: Bill the family for this week, three visits, four hours each.

entries.title: Rose approves her refill
entries.text: Rose’s blood pressure medication is due. She says yes. Kin places the order and tells her when it will arrive.
entries.speaker: Kin
entries.quote: Your refill is ready to order. It costs 42 dollars. Shall I go ahead?

entries.title: A letter is read aloud
entries.text: A letter arrives. Rose holds it in front of her phone and Kin reads it to her.
entries.speaker: Kin
entries.quote: This is from the water company. It says 61 dollars is due on the 30th. I have added it to the family’s list. Elena will see it today.

entries.title: A false demand is caught
entries.text: A man telephones Rose and says her gas account is overdue and she must pay 300 dollars today. Rose asks Kin. The family is alerted within seconds.
entries.speaker: Kin
entries.quote: I find no gas bill outstanding. Your gas bill of 57 dollars was paid on the 2nd. Please do not pay this caller. I have told Elena and Marcus.

entries.title: A big repair is shared
entries.text: The stairlift needs a repair costing 900 dollars, more than the pool holds. Kin proposes two options: a one-off top-up split by the agreed shares, or spreading the cost over several months. The siblings choose, Rose agrees, and the repair is booked.

entries.title: The month is settled
entries.text: Elena paid 180 dollars at the pharmacy from her own pocket. Ana drove Rose to four appointments. Kin calculates that Elena is owed 126 dollars and Ana 40, proposes the settlement, and on approval sends the money. Every sibling receives the same one-page statement.
entries.speaker: Kin
entries.quote: This month everything that was due has been paid, and everyone is back to their agreed share. Everything is in order.

ai.title: Understanding is the AI’s job. Certainty is not.
ai.doesTitle: The AI does the work that needs understanding
does: Reads paper bills, letters and receipts from a photograph.
Turns a spoken sentence into a bill, an approval or a question.
Turns a payment into a clear spoken sentence in the right language.
Answers questions about the family’s money from the record.
Explains who is ahead or behind, and why, in plain words.
Spots what looks wrong: duplicate bills, unusual amounts, unfamiliar payees.
ai.doesNotTitle: It does not do the work that needs certainty
doesNot: It does not do the arithmetic. Shares and settlements are calculated exactly, the same way every time.
It does not decide that a payment happened. PayPal’s record decides.
It does not move money on its own. A person confirms every movement.
It does not give legal, tax, medical or investment advice.
ai.closing: This division is deliberate. It is what lets a family trust an AI with something as sensitive as a parent’s money.

members.amara: The caregiver. Visits three mornings a week.

hero.title: The AI proposes. People approve. The record decides.
hero.lede: Kin handles a vulnerable person’s money. Trust is the product.

limits.title: Limits that no one can talk their way around.

drain.title: No one can drain the pool
drain.text: Money leaves only to approved billers, approved caregivers and members of the circle, and never above the limits in the family agreement without a second approval.

approvals.title: Two approvals for large amounts
approvals.text: Above a threshold the family sets, two members must agree. No member is the only approver of a payment to themselves.

announced.title: Every change is announced
announced.text: A new biller, a changed share or a new member is reported to everyone in the circle.

pause.title: A pause button
pause.text: Any member can freeze outgoing payments for 24 hours if something looks wrong.

pressure.title: Protection against pressure
pressure.text: Unusual patterns, such as a sudden new payee or repeated requests to the parent, are flagged to the whole circle, not to one person.

history.title: Nothing is ever deleted
history.text: A correction is added as a new entry, so the history stays intact and every line keeps its receipt and its approval.

guard.title: Every amount is checked before it is spoken.
guard.text: The AI words the sentence. It never chooses the number. Before anything is said or shown, plain code compares each amount, date and name in the sentence with the record. If anything differs, the sentence is thrown away and a fixed one is used. Your parent can never hear an amount that the record does not contain.
guard.fallback: The sentence is thrown away. Rose hears a fixed one, built from the record.

scam.title: Fraud protection grounded in fact.
scam.text: Kin does not guess whether a caller sounds suspicious. It checks whether the bill exists and whether it has been paid, tells your parent plainly, and alerts the family.
scam.roseLine: A man called about the gas bill. He says I must pay 300 dollars today. Is it real?
scam.kinLine: I find no gas bill outstanding. Your gas bill of 57 dollars was paid on the 2nd. Please do not pay this caller. I have told Elena and Marcus.
scam.rule: The family teaches one rule: Kin tells, Kin never asks for secrets. It never asks for a password, a card number or a code.
scam.checkedTitle: What Kin checked before it answered

checked.question: Was the last gas bill paid?

scam.note: Kin never calls a caller a criminal. It says what its records show, and what to do.
scam.ruleTitle: Kin tells. Kin never asks for secrets.

trust.title: Built for the person whose money it is.

items.title: Consent comes first
items.text: A circle is not active until the parent, or the person with legal authority to act for them, has agreed to it and to their role in it.

items.title: Respect for capacity
items.text: The parent’s role can change over time. Changing it needs the agreement of the circle and is recorded.

items.title: Legal authority is recorded, not assumed
items.text: Where someone holds a power of attorney or guardianship, Kin notes it. Kin does not grant authority to anyone.

items.title: Protection from the family as well as from strangers
items.text: Financial abuse of older people is most often committed by someone close to them. The limits, double approvals, full visibility and pause button exist for that reason.

items.title: Minimal data
items.text: Kin keeps financial records and receipts. It does not keep medical records, diagnoses or clinical notes.

items.title: The parent’s information belongs to the parent
items.text: The parent, or their representative, can see everything held about them and can close the circle.

items.title: Honest about what it is
items.text: Kin is not a bank, a law firm or a care provider. It does not hold funds, and it does not give legal, tax or medical advice.

items.title: An AI that admits doubt
items.text: When Kin is not sure what a document says or whether a demand is real, it says so and asks a person.

items.question: Is anyone charged today?
items.answer: No. Today Kin runs in the PayPal sandbox with test money, and nobody is charged.

items.question: What will the family plan cost?
items.answer: The price is not set. The proposal is one flat monthly fee per circle, in the range of a streaming subscription. It will be tested with pilot families first.

items.question: Does Kin hold our money?
items.answer: No. The family pool is a PayPal account that belongs to the family. Kin connects to it and never holds the money itself.

items.question: Do we need a new bank account or a new card?
items.answer: No. Each sibling pays a share through PayPal, and PayPal moves every dollar.

items.question: How is Kin’s own fee paid?
items.answer: From the pool, through a PayPal subscription. It is shared by the same split as every other cost.

items.question: Our parents live in two homes. Is that one circle or two?
items.answer: Two. There is one circle for each person cared for, so a family with two parents in different homes can run two circles.

record.title: Record
record.lede: Every movement of the circle’s money, in the order it happened. Nothing is changed or deleted. A correction is a new entry.

grid.label: Ledger entries
grid.hint: Select an entry to see its ledger lines.

record.empty: No entries of this kind this month.

circle.title: Circle
circle.lede: Who is in the circle, what each person may do, and the agreement everyone accepted.

parent.title: How {parent} takes part
parent.text: {parent}’s spoken yes is needed for anything above {amount}. Kin speaks every confirmed payment to them, and they can ask it anything.
parent.levelsLabel: How a parent can take part

decides.title: Decides
decides.text: Their spoken yes is needed above a limit the family sets.

informed.title: Informed
informed.text: They hear everything. Approvals rest with the family.

represented.title: Represented
represented.text: A person with legal authority acts for them, and Kin records it.

roleText.organizer: Approves payments and looks after the circle.
roleText.contributor: Pays a share and can give a second yes.
roleText.parent: Hears every payment and decides what is theirs to decide.
roleText.caregiver: Sees only their own bills and payments.

care.label: Care time
care.value: {rate} an hour, lowers what a member pays

payees.title: Payees
payees.text: Money leaves the pool only to these, and to members of the circle.

invite.title: Invite someone
invite.text: They join this circle the first time they sign in to Kin with this address.

createCircle.title: Start your family’s circle
createCircle.text: A circle holds one family’s shared money for one parent. You will organize it, and you can invite the others as soon as it exists.

relationship.label: You are their
relationship.hint: Optional. For example, daughter or son.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.hint: Dates and the close of each month follow it.

currency.label: Currency
currency.value: US dollars. Kin’s PayPal sandbox runs in US dollars for now.

createCircle.invited: Invited by a family? Their circle opens here as soon as you sign in with the address they used.

notices.answered: Your answer is recorded. The proposal waits for the other yeses it needs.
notices.approved: Approved. Kin pays it through PayPal and records it once PayPal confirms.
notices.refused: Your role cannot do that in this circle.
notices.freshCheck: Approving a real payment needs a fresh sign-in with your authenticator app. Use the Approve button.
notices.paused: Paused. No payment is approved for 24 hours, and everyone is told.
notices.invited: Invitation recorded. They join when they sign in to Kin with that address.
notices.invalidInvite: Enter a valid email address and choose a role.
notices.roleChanged: You now see the circle from a new seat.
notices.restarted: You have a fresh copy of Rose’s circle.
notices.circleCreated: Your circle is ready. Invite your family from the Circle screen.
notices.invalidCircle: Please fill in every field to start the circle.
notices.stepUpMissing: Your yes was not recorded: that sign-in had no second factor. Set up an authenticator app for your Kin account, then try again.
notices.stepUpStale: Your yes was not recorded: that sign-in was not fresh. Please try again.

empty.attention: Nothing needs a yes right now.

safety.title: Kin checks every demand
safety.text: When someone asks the parent for money, Kin checks it against the record and alerts the family. Nothing has been checked yet.

empty.fairness: Fairness appears once the family has agreed its shares.
empty.heard: Kin has not told {parent} anything yet. Every confirmed payment will be spoken to them.
empty.activity: No money has moved yet. Contributions and payments appear here as PayPal confirms them.
empty.spending: Nothing has been spent this month.
empty.paid: No bill has been paid this month.
empty.record: The record is empty. Every confirmed movement of money will appear here, in order.
empty.agreement: No agreement yet. The shares, the care rate and the approval thresholds are set when the family agrees them.
empty.payees: No payees yet. The companies and caregivers the circle pays appear here once they are added.

caregiverBilling.setupText: Record the rate agreed with each caregiver. Existing bills keep their original rate.
caregiverBilling.name: Payee name
caregiverBilling.formText: Enter one row per day, combining all visits on that day. Review every detail before submitting.
caregiverBilling.missingRate: Ask the organizer to record your hourly rate before you bill.
caregiverBilling.submitted: Bill submitted for family review. No payment has been made.

errors.invalid: Check the service dates and whole hours and minutes.
errors.future: Only completed service days can be billed.
errors.duplicate_date: Combine visits on the same day into one row.
errors.rate: Enter a valid positive hourly rate.
errors.amount: This bill cannot be valued safely. Check the rate and visits.
errors.refused: You cannot perform this action in this circle.
errors.missing_rate: Your hourly rate has not been recorded yet.
errors.rate_changed: Your rate changed. Change visits and review the bill again.
errors.duplicate: This service day is already billed. Change visits to correct it.
errors.key_reused: This submission was already used for a different bill. Review again.
errors.unavailable: We could not save this. Your visits are kept; please try again.
errors.not_waiting: This bill was already sent or declined. Reload to see where it stands.
errors.above_ceiling: This bill is above the agreement’s limit for one payment. Talk to the organizer.
errors.paused: The circle is paused. Send it once the pause lifts.
errors.no_agreement: The circle needs an agreement before bills can be approved.
errors.receiver: Enter the caregiver’s PayPal email address.
errors.payment_in_progress: A payment to you is waiting for approval or under way. Change the address once it is finished.
errors.model_unavailable: Kin cannot read descriptions right now. Enter the days below instead.
errors.model_refused: Kin could not read that description. Enter the days below instead.
errors.description: Write between one and a thousand characters about your visits.
errors.busy: You have asked Kin to read several descriptions recently. Please wait a while, or enter the days below.

caregiverBilling.reviewText: Check the days and the rate. Sending raises a payment proposal for the family’s approval; it pays nothing yet.
caregiverBilling.declineConfirm: Decline this bill? The caregiver can submit a corrected one.

proposalStates.failed: Payment failed · the organizer is told

caregiverBilling.receiverNone: None recorded yet. Your pay waits until you add one.
caregiverBilling.receiverText: Only you can set this. While a payment to you is waiting or under way, it cannot change.
caregiverBilling.receiverMissing: {name} has not added a PayPal address yet. Their payouts wait until they do.
caregiverBilling.describeLabel: Or describe your visits in your own words
caregiverBilling.describeHint: For example: “Monday and Tuesday, 4 hours each, and yesterday from 9 to 11.” Kin fills in the days below; you check them before anything is sent. Your rate is never shown to the AI.
caregiverBilling.described: Kin filled in the days below from your words. Check each one, then review the bill.
caregiverBilling.unclearNote: Kin could not place: {items}. Add them yourself if they belong on this bill.
caregiverBilling.droppedNote: Kin left out {count} entries it could not find in your words.

speech.readBack: {name}, here is your bill: {days}. At {rate} an hour, the total is {total}. Say yes to submit it, or no to change it.
speech.saidYes: You said yes. Submitting your bill.
speech.saidNo: You said no. Change your visits, then review again.

agreement.title: Family agreement
agreement.lede: The rules the family agreed: who shares the cost, how care time counts, and who must say yes before money moves. A change takes effect once everyone who shares the cost accepts it.
agreement.noneOrganizer: Write the first version below. It takes effect once everyone who shares the cost has accepted it.
agreement.noneOther: The organizer writes the first version, and everyone who shares the cost is asked to accept it.
agreement.sharesExample: If a month costs {amount}, Kin asks for {parts}.
agreement.careCredit: {rate} an hour, lowers what a member pays
agreement.careCash: {rate} an hour, paid out in cash
agreement.examplesText: Worked out by Kin’s approval rules, the same ones that decide every real payment.
agreement.pendingText: Proposed on {day}. It starts on {start} once everyone who shares the cost has accepted it.
agreement.scheduledText: Everyone who shares the cost has accepted it. It starts on {start}.
agreement.noChanges: Nothing changes from the version in force.

changes.careSet: Care time counts at {to} an hour
changes.careRemoved: Care time no longer counts (was {from} an hour)
changes.careCashOn: Care credit is paid out in cash
changes.careCashOff: Care credit lowers what a member pays, and is not paid out

form.text: Kin checks every term and shows exactly what changes before anything is proposed. Nothing changes until everyone who shares the cost accepts.
form.sharesHint: Percentages, up to two decimals. They must add up to 100.
form.noSharers: Invite at least one contributor, or share the cost yourself: only organizers and contributors hold a share.
form.careCounts: Count hands-on care toward what a member gives
form.careCash: Pay care credit out in cash
form.amountHint: In {currency}. An amount equal to a limit does not cross it.
form.proposed: Proposed. Everyone who shares the cost is asked to accept it.

errors.refused: Your role cannot do that in this circle.
errors.invalid: Check every field and try again.
errors.superseded: A newer version replaced this one. Reload to see it.
errors.no_shares: Give at least one member a share.
errors.share: Each share is a percentage above 0 and at most 100, with up to two decimals.
errors.share_member: Only organizers and contributors can hold a share.
errors.duplicate_member: Each member can hold only one share.
errors.shares_total: The shares must add up to exactly 100%.
errors.ceiling: The largest single payment must be above zero.
errors.threshold: Enter each amount as a positive number.
errors.threshold_above_ceiling: No limit can be above the largest single payment.
errors.care_rate: Enter the value of an hour of care, above zero.
errors.effective_date: The start date must be today or later.
errors.unavailable: We could not save this. Your entries are kept; please try again.

agreement.attention: Version {version} of the family agreement waits for your acceptance
agreement.parentNotDeciding: {amount}, not used while {parent} does not decide payments

speech.listening: Listening. Press Stop when you have finished.
speech.working: Kin is writing down what you said…
speech.micDenied: Kin cannot use your microphone. Allow it in your browser, or type instead.
speech.noVoice: Kin cannot speak this language aloud yet. The words are on the screen.

errors.refused: Your role cannot do that in this circle.
errors.invalid: Kin could not use that. Please try again.
errors.speech_unavailable: Kin cannot listen or speak right now. Use the buttons and fields instead.
errors.recording: The recording was empty or longer than a minute. Please try again.
errors.busy: You have used Kin’s voice a lot recently. Please wait a while.
errors.no_voice: Kin cannot speak this language aloud yet. The words are on the screen.
errors.unclear: Kin did not hear a clear yes or no. Please try again.
errors.not_confirmed: Nothing was recorded: Kin did not hear a clear yes to confirm.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong. Please try again.
